title: Checkbox toggles by task title instead of id
summary: The task checkbox in app/page.tsx calls toggle with task.title instead of task.id, so the PATCH targets /api/tasks/<title> and 404s; the task's done flag is never flipped and the UI does not change. The "completing a task..." test fails because the active counter still reads 1 after the click.

expectedFailure.testTitle: completing a task updates the counter and the Done filter
